description: Use this when you need a Bitcoin address's balance or recent activity (payment checks, wallet lookups, due diligence). Balance (confirmed + pending) in sats, BTC and USD, address type, total received / sent, tx count, and up to 25 recent transactions with net change for this address, fee rate and confirmation status. Works for bc1 (SegWit/Taproot), 1... and 3... addresses. mempool.space with Blockstream Esplora failover, cached 60 s. Returns JSON with: ok, data, sources, fetched_at, cache_age_s. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/btc-address
name: btc_address
title: Btc Address
